cold_generation_contract: no old runtime answers read; every answer uses the context/messages of THIS round's own generation

enforced_pre_request.service_boundary: every ServiceBoundary.call (embedding/llm/pg groups, including local_adapter readonly_select_chunks); embedding batch texts/chars caps judged on the ACTUAL positional-or-keyword shape
enforced_pre_request.qdrant_native_wrapper: query_points/retrieve via BudgetedQdrantClient — reserve before the native call, issued only when it is entered
enforced_pre_request.neo4j_native_wrapper: BOTH driver.session().run(...) and the async-with entered session run through _BudgetedNeo4jSession (one gate + one issued mark per real run; __aenter__/__aexit__ and close ownership delegate unchanged)
enforced_pre_request.pg_data_sql: fetch/fetchrow/fetchval on the explicit AND on every self-made connection (asyncpg.connect is scoped-patched per leg: answer's own connection, SourceAdapter read-back, fusion/rerank guard reads, local_adapter provenance reads)
enforced_pre_request.rerank_and_answer_model: reserved before the accepted entries run; issuance reconciled ONLY from the entries' real HTTP receipts — answer_llm from model_calls_used (runtime included on the exception path), rerank from the call receipt of THIS question's result entry or failure_service_records whose query_id IS this question (a foreign question's in-flight call never counts; the mere existence of some failure never proves this question stopped before HTTP; only a named pre-flight/identity guard stage is an explicit before-http zero; otherwise unknown) — executed 401/timeout counts, skip/refusal 0, unknown is explicit and unbilled; the three-state status is published onto the leg record and terminal even when the leg raises

not_billed: connection establishment and close (readonly/timeout/server_settings pass through to the owning code path)
transaction control: BEGIN/COMMIT via conn.transaction and SET LOCAL via conn.execute — audited to carry no data SQL in the read-only evaluation paths
run-level pre/post identity capture (guard reads outside per-question envelopes)
native client methods not recorded by the accepted wrappers (identical coverage to the accepted recording contract — declared, not hidden)
